title: MultiPartyTurnBench: Benchmarking Floor Control in Multi-Party Spoken Dialogue

paragraphs.en: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5–92.6% EOT recall at 4.3–11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1–95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9–54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 全双工语音系统必须决定何时进入、保持或放弃对话权，即使有多名说话者同时发言或进行反馈性回应而未实际获得对话权。 现有的评估方法研究的是两人对话中的轮替行为或端到端的智能体行为，但缺乏对多参与者场景中真实对话权转移与易混淆的非事件之间的统一、受控评估。 我们提出了 MultiPartyTurnBench（MPTB），这是一个基准测试，包含 240 段通过合成生成的、频道分离的对话，涵盖两到五名说话者和六种互动类型。 MPTB 评估两项互补的任务：轮替结束（EOT）检测用于区分真正的轮替完成与临时保持对话权，而打断（INT）检测则用于区分成功的对话权夺取与未实际获得对话权的发言。 精确的事件条件标注使得能够使用限制假阳率的召回率和带符号的延迟指标进行因果评估。 在声学、语义和轮替预测等基线模型中，我们发现存在显著不对称性：学习系统实现的 EOT 召回率可达 82.5%–92.6%，但假阳性率高达 4.3%–11.8%；而 INT 检测则面临漏检对话权夺取或过度误触发的问题。 这种不对称性也体现在五个全双工智能体上：它们在轮替进入任务上的平衡准确率可达 86.1%–95.8%，但在选择性打断处理方面的表现却接近随机水平（46.9%–54.7%）。 Gemini-3.8-Live 对 97.7% 的反馈性回应做出了让步，而 MiniCPM-o-4.5 仅对 1.4% 的真实打断做出了让步。 这些发现表明，选择性地控制对话权是可靠多参与者语音互动中一个独特且尚未解决的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Full-duplex speech systems must continuously decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor while processing ongoing speech ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . These decisions require more than detecting speech activity: a speaker may pause without yielding the floor, while a listener may backchannel without attempting to take it ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Yngve, 1970 ) . Misinterpreting either can cause an agent to respond prematurely or unnecessarily abandon its own response, even when its language understanding is otherwise correct ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 全双工语音系统必须持续决定何时进入、保持或放弃对话发言权，同时处理正在进行的语音（Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022；Peng et al., 2025）。 这些决策不仅需要检测语音活动：说话者可能暂停但并不放弃发言权，而倾听者可能通过反馈回应却并未试图夺取发言权（Sacks et al., 1974；Yngve, 1970）。 对其中任何一种情况误解，都可能导致智能体过早回应或不必要地放弃自己的回应，即使其语言理解在其他方面是正确的（Xia et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: This distinction becomes particularly important in multi-party conversation, where several listeners may backchannel, overlap, or interject while the current speaker retains the floor. Existing evaluations address complementary aspects of this problem: dyadic benchmarks distinguish turn endings and interruptions in 2-party settings ( Jiang and others, 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) , natural multi-party corpora study next-speaker prediction ( Triadic-VAP, 2025 ; Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , and full-duplex agent benchmarks assess speaking and stopping behavior ( Lin and others, 2025 ; Lin and others, 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . However, the joint evaluation of genuine floor relinquishment and successful floor acquisition under controlled multi-party conditions remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 在多轮对话中，这种区分变得尤为重要：当当前说话者仍保持发言权时，多位听众可能会发出反馈、打断发言或插话。 现有的评估方法解决了该问题的不同方面：双人基准测试能区分两人对话中的回合结束与打断（Jiang 等，2026；Xia 等，2026）；自然的多轮语料库则研究下一位说话者的预测问题（Triadic-VAP，2025；Qi 和 Skantze，2026）；而全双工智能体基准测试则评估了发言与停止行为（Lin 等，2025；Lin 等，2026；Ma 等，2026）。 然而，在受控的多轮对话条件下，对真正的发言权移交与成功的发言权获取进行联合评估的研究仍显不足。

MPTB evaluates two complementary decisions: End-of-Turn ( EOT ) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption ( INT ) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from backchannels and other non-floor-taking speech. The benchmark comprises 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations balanced across N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} speakers and six interaction types. A discrete-event orchestrator establishes floor ownership and event timing before speech synthesis, enabling controlled variation in speaker count, interaction dynamics, and acoustic conditions. At qualified operating points, systems recover up to 92.6% of turn endings but only 56.2% of successful interruptions; acoustic detectors achieve higher recall only at excessive false-positive rates. Complementary real-speech evaluation further shows that interruption detection remains challenging in natural multi-party meetings. paragraphs.en: MultiPartyTurnBench , a controlled benchmark of 240 multi-party conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types, with exact event-state annotations for end-of-turn (EOT) and interruption (INT) detection.

paragraphs.en: End-to-end validation across five full-duplex voice agents , exposing near-chance selective yielding despite strong turn-entry performance, with opposing tendencies to yield indiscriminately or ignore genuine interruptions.
paragraphs.zh: 五个全双工语音智能体的端到端验证显示，尽管其在回合开启阶段表现优异，但选择性让话的能力几乎处于随机水平，且存在两种相反倾向：要么无差别地让话，要么完全忽略真正的打断。

paragraphs.en: Conversational floor management involves turn transitions, interruptions, backchannels, and competing speaker claims ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Duncan, 1972 ; Yngve, 1970 ) . Talking Turns ( Arora et al., 2025a ) evaluates turn-taking in audio foundation models, while TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) established causal EOT and interruption detection in dyadic conversational styles. paragraphs.en: MultiPartyTurnBench evaluates whether systems can causally infer changes in conversational floor ownership from ongoing multi-speaker audio. It defines two complementary, event-conditioned tasks: (i) End-of-Turn (EOT) asks whether the current speaker has relinquished the floor and aims to detect genuine floor relinquishment by the current speaker, anchored at speech offset against hard negatives such as mid-turn pauses where the speaker retains the floor. (ii) Interruption (INT) asks whether another speaker has successfully acquired the floor and detects successful floor acquisition by another speaker, anchored at the interrupting speech onset, against hard negatives like backchannels and non-content vocalizations that leave floor ownership unchanged. Unsuccessful interruption attempts are excluded because their outcomes may only become apparent through subsequent interaction, making them ambiguous at onset for a causal detector ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) . Together, the two tracks evaluate floor relinquishment and acquisition against behaviorally confusable non-events, rather than speech activity alone (Table 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: MultiPartyTurnBench 评估系统能否从持续的多说话者音频中因果推断出对话发言权的变更。 它定义了两种互补的、以事件为条件的任务：(i) 轮次结束（EOT）任务旨在判断当前说话者是否已放弃发言权，并试图通过以语音结束时刻为锚点的方式检测当前说话者的真实发言权放弃行为，同时排除诸如轮次中段的停顿等难以区分的负例，此时说话者仍保留发言权。 (ii) 打断（INT）任务旨在判断其他说话者是否成功获得了发言权，并试图通过以打断语音的起始时刻为锚点的方式检测其他说话者的成功发言权获取行为，同时排除诸如反馈性回应和非内容性发声等难以区分的负例，这些行为不会改变发言权的归属。 失败的打断尝试被排除在外，因为其结果可能只有在后续互动中才会显现，这使得在打断开始时对于因果推断器而言难以明确判断（Jiang 等人，2026）。 这两项任务共同评估了发言权的放弃与获取行为，并将其与行为上容易混淆的非事件区分开来，而不仅仅依赖语音活动本身（表 2）。

paragraphs.en: MPTB is designed to isolate floor-control decisions under independently controlled interaction conditions with exact event boundaries. In natural multi-party recordings, speaker count, overlap, listener activity, and acoustics vary jointly, complicating controlled analysis. We construct each conversation from an explicit floor-state representation before rendering speech in three steps: (1) define the event taxonomy for floor ownership changes; (2) select the interaction conditions and dialogue scripts; (3) staged generation pipeline renders synchronized multi-speaker audio recordings.
paragraphs.zh: MPTB 旨在通过具有精确事件边界的独立可控互动条件，隔离话语轮次控制决策。 在自然的多方对话录音中，说话者数量、话语重叠、听众活动以及声学环境会共同变化，这使得受控分析变得复杂。 我们在生成语音之前，首先基于明确的话语轮次状态表示构建每段对话，整个过程分为三步：（1）定义话语轮次所有权变化的事件分类体系；（2）选择互动条件和对话脚本；（3）通过分阶段生成流程渲染同步的多说话者音频录音。

Backchannel captures listener speech without claiming the floor, and Noncontent captures non-linguistic activity without changing floor ownership. Table 2 maps these events to the EOT and INT evaluation targets.

paragraphs.en: 1. Event-conditioned dialogue generation. Off-the-shelf LLM like GPT-4.1 generates multi-party scripts conditioned on speaker count, interaction type, topic, narrative plot, and target turn-taking statistics. A restricted event vocabulary ( TURN , CLAIM_FLOOR , VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM ) specifies conversational actions, with backchannel and interruption frequencies guided by TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) . The LLM determines linguistic content and proposes listener actions but does not assign final timestamps or resolve floor ownership. Scripts are schema-validated, with malformed outputs regenerated or rejected.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 事件条件化的对话生成。 GPT-4.1 这类现成的 LLM 会根据说话者数量、互动类型、话题、叙事情节以及目标轮次交替统计数据，生成多角色对话脚本。 一个受限的事件词汇表（TURN、CLAIM_FLOOR、VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM）用于定义对话行为，其中回应对话和打断的频率由 TurnBench（Jiang 等人，2026）指导。 LLM 负责确定语言内容并提出听众行为，但不会分配最终的时间戳或解决发言权归属问题。 脚本会经过模式验证，格式错误的输出会被重新生成或拒绝。

paragraphs.en: 2. Floor-state orchestration. A discrete-event orchestrator maintains the current floor holder and resolves symbolic actions into realized transitions: TURN becomes a hold, yield, or interruption-forced termination; CLAIM_FLOOR resolves either to a successful Interruption or a Non-Floor-Taking Interruption ; and VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM produces a backchannel or related non-floor-changing event. The orchestrator assigns turn durations, inter-speaker gaps, pauses, and interruption overlap based on real-world timing statistics from AMI corpus ( Carletta and others, 2006 ) . Explicit mid-turn pauses provide EOT hard negatives. The resulting placement schedule and canonical event log define exact EOT and INT anchors.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 楼层状态协调。 一个离散事件协调器维护当前的楼层持有者，并将符号性动作解析为实际发生的转换：TURN 会转化为保持、让出或被中断强制终止；CLAIM_FLOOR 会解析为成功的中断或非占取楼层的中断；而 VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM 则会产生反馈通道或相关的非楼层变更事件。 该协调器根据 AMI 语料库中的现实世界时间统计（Carletta 等人，2006）分配轮次时长、说话者之间的间隔、停顿以及中断的重叠。 明确的轮次中途停顿提供了明确结束点（EOT）的硬性负例。 由此产生的安排时间表和标准事件日志定义了精确的明确结束点（EOT）和中断（INT）锚点。

paragraphs.en: 4. Acoustic scene rendering. Synthesized speech is placed on synchronized speaker channels according to the orchestrated timeline, preserving overlap determined by floor-state transitions. Successful interruptions end with a short fade applied at the truncation boundary, and channels are peak-normalized independently. A shared voice-free ambient bed (filtered pink noise and humming) is mixed at a per-conversation SNR. MUSAN ( Snyder et al., 2015 ) sound effects and intermittent distant third-party speech introduces nuisance activity to stress false-positive detection; neither creates benchmark-positive floor events.
paragraphs.zh: 4. 声学场景渲染。 合成的语音按照编排好的时间线放置到同步的扬声器通道中，同时保留由楼层状态转换所决定的重叠部分。 成功的打断会在截断边界处应用一个短促的渐隐效果结束，并且各通道会独立进行峰值归一化。 一个共享的无语音环境底噪（经过滤波的粉噪和嗡鸣声）会以每次对话特定的信噪比进行混音。 MUSAN（Snyder 等人，2015）中的音效以及间歇性的远处第三方语音会引入干扰活动，以测试误检；但两者都不会产生基准阳性环境事件。

paragraphs.en: Prediction and Event Matching. Per-speaker model scores are converted to discrete events through threshold crossings with a 2 s refractory period. Following TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) , each gold positive at t i t_{i} is matched one-to-one to the earliest unmatched prediction within [ t i − 0.25 , t i + 3.0 ] [t_{i}-0.25,\;t_{i}+3.0] s. Matched events are true positives (TP), while unmatched gold positives are false negatives (FN). Hard negatives are scored as temporal spans: any detection within a span counts as a false positive (FP), otherwise a true negative (TN). Predictions outside scored regions are ignored.
paragraphs.zh: 预测与事件匹配。 每位说话者的模型分数通过阈值穿越转换为离散事件，并设置 2 秒的不应期。 遵循 TurnBench（Jiang 等人，2026），每个在 t_i 时刻的黄金正样本会与 [t_i - 0.25, t_i + 3.0] 秒内最早未匹配到的预测进行一对一匹配。 已匹配的事件为真阳性（TP），而未匹配的黄金正样本则为假阴性（FN）。 难负样本按时间跨度评分：该跨度内的任何检测均计为假阳性（FP），否则计为真阴性（TN）。 评分区域之外的预测将被忽略。

paragraphs.en: Offline EOT and INT Evaluation. We evaluate 12 systems across three families: acoustic VAD (RMS Energy, WebRTC VAD ( Google WebRTC Project, ) , Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) ); semantic endpointers (Smart Turn v2 ( Pipecat AI, 2025 ) , Kyutai SVAD ( Kyutai, ) , Mimi Endpointer ( Udupa et al., 2025 ) ); and turn-taking models (VAP ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ) , MuVAP ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , DualTurn ( Rajaa, 2026 ) , WavLM-Large anchor ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Turn-1-Mini ( p99lab, 2026 ) , ESPnet Turn-Taking ( Arora et al., 2025b ) ). VAP is adapted to multi-party audio through speaker-versus-rest inference. We report EOT and INT performance across speaker-count and interaction-type breakdowns using development-selected operating points. See Appendix E.1 and F.4 for model configurations and score mappings.
paragraphs.zh: 离线 EOT 和 INT 评估。 我们在三个系统家族中评估了 12 个系统：声学 VAD（RMS Energy、WebRTC VAD（Google WebRTC Project）、Silero VAD（Silero Team，2024））；语义终点检测器（Smart Turn v2（Pipecat AI，2025）、Kyutai SVAD（Kyutai）、Mimi Endpointer（Udupa 等人，2025））；以及轮次转换模型（VAP（Ekstedt 和 Skantze，2022）、MuVAP（Qi 和 Skantze，2026）、DualTurn（Rajaa，2026）、WavLM-Large anchor（Chen 等人，2022）、Turn-1-Mini（p99lab，2026）、ESPnet Turn-Taking（Arora 等人，2025b））。 VAP 通过说话者与其他人对比的推理方法被适配到多参与者音频中。 我们使用开发阶段选定的运行点，报告了在不同说话者数量和交流类型划分下的 EOT 和 INT 性能。 模型配置和分数映射请参见附录 E.1 和 F.4。

sents.en: Offline EOT and INT Evaluation.
sents.zh: 离线 EOT 和 INT 评估。

sents.en: We evaluate 12 systems across three families: acoustic VAD (RMS Energy, WebRTC VAD ( Google WebRTC Project, ) , Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) ); semantic endpointers (Smart Turn v2 ( Pipecat AI, 2025 ) , Kyutai SVAD ( Kyutai, ) , Mimi Endpointer ( Udupa et al., 2025 ) ); and turn-taking models (VAP ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ) , MuVAP ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , DualTurn ( Rajaa, 2026 ) , WavLM-Large anchor ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Turn-1-Mini ( p99lab, 2026 ) , ESPnet Turn-Taking ( Arora et al., 2025b ) ).
sents.zh: 我们在三个系统家族中评估了 12 个系统：声学 VAD（RMS Energy、WebRTC VAD（Google WebRTC Project）、Silero VAD（Silero Team，2024））；语义终点检测器（Smart Turn v2（Pipecat AI，2025）、Kyutai SVAD（Kyutai）、Mimi Endpointer（Udupa 等人，2025））；以及轮次转换模型（VAP（Ekstedt 和 Skantze，2022）、MuVAP（Qi 和 Skantze，2026）、DualTurn（Rajaa，2026）、WavLM-Large anchor（Chen 等人，2022）、Turn-1-Mini（p99lab，2026）、ESPnet Turn-Taking（Arora 等人，2025b））。

sents.en: VAP is adapted to multi-party audio through speaker-versus-rest inference.
sents.zh: VAP 通过说话者与其他人对比的推理方法被适配到多参与者音频中。

sents.en: We report EOT and INT performance across speaker-count and interaction-type breakdowns using development-selected operating points.
sents.zh: 我们使用开发阶段选定的运行点，报告了在不同说话者数量和交流类型划分下的 EOT 和 INT 性能。

paragraphs.en: Full Duplex Agent Evaluation. We test five full-duplex voice agents— GPT-Live-1 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.8-Live ( Google, 2026 ) , MiniCPM-o-4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , Realtime-Venus ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , and Step-Audio3-Realtime ( Lin et al., 2026a ) —on 120 interactive floor-control scenarios, repeated three times per system. These experiments distinguish offline event detection from agents’ observable decisions to enter or relinquish the conversational floor. See Appendix E for scoring configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 全双工智能体评估。 我们对五个全双工语音智能体——GPT-Live-1（OpenAI，2026）、Gemini-3.8-Live（Google，2026）、MiniCPM-o-4.5（Cui 等，2026）、Realtime-Venus（Zhao 等，2026a）和 Step-Audio3-Realtime（Lin 等，2026a）——在 120 个交互式对话轮次控制场景中进行测试，每个系统重复三次。 这些实验将离线事件检测与智能体可观察的进入或放弃对话轮次的决策区分开来。 评分配置请参见附录 E。

paragraphs.en: Turn completion is comparatively tractable; successful floor acquisition is not. Table 3 reveals a pronounced asymmetry between the two floor-control decisions. VAP and Kyutai SVAD achieve comparable EOT recall (92.6% and 92.5%) at low FPR (7.5% and 4.3%), yet recover only 11.7% and 56.2% of successful interruptions, respectively. Even the strongest qualified INT detector misses nearly half of genuine takeovers. Thus, recognizing when a speaker has finished does not translate into determining whether incoming speech has actually displaced the current floor holder.
paragraphs.zh: 判断发言结束相对容易；而成功获取发言权则不然。 表3显示，在两种发言权控制决策之间存在显著的不对称性。 VAP和Kyutai SVAD在低FPR（分别为7.5%和4.3%）时实现了相当高的EOT召回率（92.6%和92.5%），但成功中断的恢复率却仅为11.7%和56.2%。 即便是性能最强的合格INT检测器，也会漏检近一半的真实发言权夺取事件。 因此，识别说话者何时结束发言，并不等同于判断新传入的语音是否真正取代了当前的发言权持有者。

paragraphs.en: High recall without selectivity is insufficient for conversational control. Acoustic detectors illustrate why floor transitions cannot be reduced to speech activity. Silero VAD achieves 97.2% EOT and 85.4% INT recall, but incurs prohibitive FPRs of 93.5% and 89.2%. Semantic and turn-taking models suppress these false activations, often at the cost of missed takeovers: Mimi Endpointer achieves 90.5% EOT recall but detects only 13.9% of interruptions. This exposes the central challenge: distinguishing genuine floor claims from listener activity that leaves floor ownership unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 缺乏选择性的高召回率对于对话控制而言是不足的。 声学检测器说明了为何不能将话语权的转移简化为语音活动。 Silero VAD 实现了 97.2% 的 EOT 召回率和 85.4% 的 INT 召回率，但带来了高达 93.5% 和 89.2% 的不可接受的 FPR。 语义模型和轮替模型能够抑制这些误触发，但往往以漏检话语权转移为代价：Mimi Endpointer 实现了 90.5% 的 EOT 召回率，却仅能检测到 13.9% 的中断。 这揭示了核心挑战：如何区分真正的话语权主张与那些并未改变话语权归属的听众活动。

paragraphs.en: Detection quality and latency trade-offs. Even among strong EOT detectors, comparable recall conceals substantial timing differences. VAP detects turn endings at 143 ms p50, versus 1,829 ms for Kyutai SVAD, despite nearly identical recall. Thus, a correct floor transition detected too late may still disrupt natural interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 检测质量与延迟之间的权衡。 即使在强大的 EOT 检测器中，相似的召回率也掩盖了显著的时间差异。 VAP 在 p50 时以 143 毫秒检测到回合结束，而 Kyutai SVAD 则需要 1,829 毫秒，尽管两者的召回率几乎相同。 因此，即使正确检测到了楼层转换，但如果检测时间过晚，仍然可能破坏自然的交互。

paragraphs.en: More speakers do not produce uniform degradation in EOT detection. Figure 4 shows that EOT detection remains comparatively stable across two to five speakers. VAP maintains 92–93% recall, while MuVAP and DualTurn show similarly small variations. Surprisingly, Kyutai improves from 84.6% to 96.6%, suggesting that increasing speaker count does not inherently make turn completion harder under MPTB’s controlled conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 更多说话者并不会导致 EOT 检测性能均匀下降。 图 4 显示，在 2 到 5 名说话者的情况下，EOT 检测性能保持相对稳定。 VAP 的召回率维持在 92%–93%，而 MuVAP 和 DualTurn 的变化同样很小。 令人意外的是，Kyutai 的性能从 84.6% 提升到了 96.6%，这表明在 MPTB 的受控条件下，增加说话者数量本身并不会使轮次完成变得更具挑战性。

sents.en: More speakers do not produce uniform degradation in EOT detection.
sents.zh: 更多说话者并不会导致 EOT 检测性能均匀下降。

sents.en: Figure 4 shows that EOT detection remains comparatively stable across two to five speakers.
sents.zh: 图 4 显示，在 2 到 5 名说话者的情况下，EOT 检测性能保持相对稳定。

sents.en: VAP maintains 92–93% recall, while MuVAP and DualTurn show similarly small variations.
sents.zh: VAP 的召回率维持在 92%–93%，而 MuVAP 和 DualTurn 的变化同样很小。

sents.en: Surprisingly, Kyutai improves from 84.6% to 96.6%, suggesting that increasing speaker count does not inherently make turn completion harder under MPTB’s controlled conditions.
sents.zh: 令人意外的是，Kyutai 的性能从 84.6% 提升到了 96.6%，这表明在 MPTB 的受控条件下，增加说话者数量本身并不会使轮次完成变得更具挑战性。

paragraphs.en: Interruption detection exhibits opposing speaker-count trends. Kyutai’s INT recall declines from 63.3% to 48.7% as speaker count increases from two to five, whereas MuVAP improves from 23.3% to 40.8%, with DualTurn showing a similar upward trend. Yet no model exceeds 50% INT recall at five speakers. These opposing trajectories suggest that models exploit multi-speaker context differently when interpreting competing floor claims. Relational speaker modeling may offer advantages over channel-local endpointing. Speaker count therefore exposes model-specific vulnerabilities rather than a universal scaling penalty. See Appendix F.3 for recall–FPR breakdowns across speaker counts.
paragraphs.zh: 中断检测在不同说话人数下呈现出相反的趋势。 当说话人数从两人增加到五人时，Kyutai 的 INT 召回率从 63.3% 下降至 48.7%，而 MuVAP 则从 23.3% 提升至 40.8%，DualTurn 也表现出类似的上升趋势。 然而，在五人说话的情况下，没有任何模型的 INT 召回率超过 50%。 这些相反的趋势表明，模型在解释相互竞争的发言权主张时，对多说话人上下文的处理方式存在差异。 关系型说话人建模可能比基于通道的局部终点检测更具优势。 因此，说话人数的变化暴露的是模型特有的弱点，而非一种普适的扩展性能惩罚。 关于不同说话人数下的召回率–FPR 分解分析，请参见附录 F.3。

paragraphs.en: Interruption detection is substantially more sensitive to interaction style. Figure 5 (and Appendix F.2 ) shows that EOT detection remains comparatively stable across interaction types with limited variation. In contrast, INT recall shows large swings under the same threshold (Kyutai SVAD is 47.0% in collaborative dialogue to 77.5% in instructional exchanges). This disparity suggests that EOT detection generalizes more consistently across interaction regimes compared to INT detection.
paragraphs.zh: 中断检测对交互风格的变化要敏感得多。 图 5（以及附录 F.2）显示，EOT 检测在不同交互类型中保持相对稳定，变化有限。 相比之下，INT 召回率在相同阈值下波动较大（Kyutai SVAD 在协作对话中为 47.0%，而在指令性交流中则高达 77.5%）。 这种差异表明，与 INT 检测相比，EOT 检测在不同交互模式中的泛化能力更为一致。

sents.en: Interruption detection is substantially more sensitive to interaction style.
sents.zh: 中断检测对交互风格的变化要敏感得多。

paragraphs.en: Conversational difficulty is model-dependent. Kyutai struggles most with collaborative exchanges, while MuVAP performs worst on narrative dialogue (25.0% INT recall), DualTurn on task-oriented interactions (32.6%), and VAP and Mimi Endpointer on argumentative exchanges. These contrasting failures suggest that models rely on different conversational cues when interpreting floor claims, rather than a shared hierarchy of interaction difficulty. See Appendix I for qualitative examples.
paragraphs.zh: 对话难度因模型而异。 Kyutai 在协作性交流中表现最差，而 MuVAP 在叙事性对话（INT 召回率为 25.0%）中表现最弱，DualTurn 在任务导向型互动中表现最差（32.6%），VAP 和 Mimi Endpointer 则在论辩性交流中表现不佳。 这些截然不同的失败表明，模型在解读发言权主张时依赖不同的对话线索，而非一个共同的互动难度层级体系。 定性示例请参见附录 I。

paragraphs.en: Table 4 extends offline detection to observable behavior in five full-duplex agents. Four systems achieve 86.1–95.8% START balanced accuracy, reliably distinguishing genuine turn endings from mid-turn holds. Yet this competence collapses when deciding whether to yield: all five achieve only 46.9–54.7% STOP balanced accuracy, with confidence intervals including chance performance. The offline EOT–INT asymmetry thus manifests directly in agent behavior: models recognize end of turn but struggle to determine when incoming speech interruptions.
paragraphs.zh: 表 4 将离线检测扩展到了五个全双工智能体中可观察的行为。 四个系统实现了 86.1%–95.8% 的 START 平衡准确率，能够可靠地区分真正的轮次结束与轮次中途的停顿。 然而，在判断是否让行时，这种能力却完全失效：五个系统的 STOP 平衡准确率均仅为 46.9%–54.7%，置信区间甚至包含了随机表现的范围。 因此，离线 EOT–INT 的不对称性直接体现在智能体的行为中：模型能够识别轮次的结束，但难以判断何时出现对输入语音的打断。

paragraphs.en: Gemini-3.8-Live effectively surrendering the floor indiscriminately (97.7% of backchannels, bias + 0.98 +0.98 ). Conversely, MiniCPM-o-4.5 almost never yields, ignoring 98.6% of genuine interruptions (bias − 0.99 -0.99 ). Realtime-Venus similarly resists yielding, while GPT-Live-1 is more balanced but remains unreliable. These opposing behaviors suggest inability of the voice agents to distinguish the conversational significance of incoming audio (see Appendix G ).

sents.en: Conversely, MiniCPM-o-4.5 almost never yields, ignoring 98.6% of genuine interruptions (bias − 0.99 -0.99 ).

sents.en: Realtime-Venus similarly resists yielding, while GPT-Live-1 is more balanced but remains unreliable.
sents.zh: Realtime-Venus 同样拒绝让步，而 GPT-Live-1 则更为平衡，但仍不可靠。

sents.en: These opposing behaviors suggest inability of the voice agents to distinguish the conversational significance of incoming audio (see Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 这些相反的行为表明，语音智能体无法区分传入音频在对话中的重要性（参见附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Multi-party floor control requires reasoning about speaker roles, not merely speech activity. MPTB exposes a fundamental limitation of conventional endpointing: incoming speech does not necessarily imply a change in floor ownership. Reliable interruption handling in multi-speaker settings requires distinguishing competing floor claims from backchannels and other non-floor-taking activity, conditioned on the current speaker and conversational context. This motivates event-conditioned modeling of floor transitions rather than independent speech-activity decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 多方发言权控制需要推理发言者的角色，而不仅仅是识别言语活动。 MPTB 揭示了传统终点检测的一个根本性局限：传入的语音并不必然意味着发言权的转移。 在多发言人场景下实现可靠的打断处理，需要根据当前发言者和对话语境，将相互竞争的发言权主张与反馈信号及其他非发言权获取行为区分开来。 这促使我们采用基于事件条件的发言权转换建模方法，而非独立的言语活动决策方式。

paragraphs.en: Floor-control evaluation must capture the consequences of incorrect decisions. High event recall can conceal excessive false activations, while conservative yielding policies can appear reliable despite missing genuine interruptions. MPTB demonstrates the importance of evaluation breakdowns across speaker counts and interaction regimes. Such diagnostics expose failure modes obscured by aggregate scores and provide actionable targets for developing more selective full-duplex systems.
paragraphs.zh: 楼层控制评估必须能够反映错误决策所带来的后果。 事件召回率过高可能会掩盖过多的误触发，而过于保守的让行策略即便漏掉了真实的打断，也可能显得可靠。 MPTB 证明了在不同说话者数量和交流模式下，评估方法失效的重要性。 这类诊断能够揭示被综合分数所掩盖的故障模式，并为开发更具选择性的全双工系统提供可操作的改进方向。

This supports corroborating learnings from synthetic evaluations to real-world relevance of the interruption challenge.

paragraphs.en: We introduced MultiPartyTurnBench , a controlled benchmark for turn taking dynamics for end-of-turn and interruption detection in multi-party spoken dialogues. Existing systems detect turn completion reliably but struggle to recognize floor takeovers without excessive false activations, with failures varying across conversational regimes and speaker counts. This asymmetry extends to full-duplex agents where all systems perform near chance on selective yielding. MultiPartyTurnBench establishes selective interruption handling as a critical unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 MultiPartyTurnBench，这是一个用于控制多人口语对话中轮次动态、轮次结束检测和打断检测的基准测试。 现有系统能够可靠地检测轮次结束，但在识别话语权的转移时却存在困难，容易出现过多的误触发，且失败情况会因对话模式和说话者数量的不同而有所差异。 这种不对称性也体现在全双工智能体中，所有系统在选择性让话方面的表现都接近随机水平。 MultiPartyTurnBench 表明，选择性打断处理是构建可靠多人语音交互所面临的一个关键而未解决的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic speech and external validity. MPTB’s controlled construction provides exact floor-state annotations and reproducible interaction conditions, but synthesized speech cannot fully capture the prosody, disfluencies, timing adaptations, and ambiguous floor negotiations of spontaneous conversation. The synthetic-to-real comparison (Table 24 ) reveals non-uniform difficulty: learned endpointers generally achieve higher EOT recall on MPTB, whereas VAP detects fewer interruptions on MPTB (11.7%) than on real four-party AMI (35.9%). Thus, synthetic evaluation does not uniformly overestimate performance, and MPTB scores should be interpreted as controlled diagnostics rather than estimates of natural-conversation error rates.
paragraphs.zh: 合成语音与外部效度。 MPTB 的受控构建提供了精确的对话轮次状态标注和可重复的交互条件，但合成语音无法完全捕捉自然对话中的韵律、流畅性中断、时间调整以及模糊的对话轮次协商。 合成语与真实语的比较（表 24）显示难度并不一致：经过训练的终点检测器在 MPTB 上通常能实现更高的 EOT 召回率，而 VAP 在 MPTB 上检测到的打断次数（11.7%）少于真实四方 AMI 对话中的打断次数（35.9%）。 因此，合成评估并不会一致地高估性能，MPTB 的得分应被理解为受控诊断结果，而非自然对话中错误率的具体估计值。

paragraphs.en: Scope of real-speech validation. Our multi-party validation uses 15 four-speaker AMI meetings with floor events derived from manual speech segments rather than independently annotated under the MPTB taxonomy. The evaluated corpora also differ in speaker count, conversational domain, acoustics, annotation protocols, and threshold calibration, with real-audio slices using in-slice tuning. Cross-corpus differences therefore cannot be attributed causally to speaker count or synthetic speech. AMI provides complementary evidence that interruption detection remains challenging in natural multi-party conversation, but does not establish direct synthetic-to-real performance transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 真实语音验证的范围。 我们的多方验证使用了 15 场四人参与的 AMI 会议，其中的对话事件是从人工标注的语音片段中提取的，而非根据 MPTB 分类体系独立标注的。 所评估的语料库在说话者数量、对话领域、声学特性、标注协议和阈值校准方面也存在差异，其中真实音频片段采用了片段内调优方法。 因此，跨语料库的差异不能归因于说话者数量或合成语音本身。 AMI 提供了补充证据，表明在自然的多方对话中，打断检测仍然具有挑战性，但这并未证明性能可以直接从合成语音迁移到真实语音。

paragraphs.en: Linguistic and demographic coverage. MPTB is restricted to English, with accent diversity limited to the voices sampled during synthesis rather than representative real-world speaker populations. We do not systematically evaluate generalization across languages, regional accents, or speaker demographics. Turn-taking conventions, prosodic cues, and interruption behaviors may vary across linguistic and sociocultural contexts. Consequently, our findings should not be interpreted as universal patterns of conversational floor control; broader multilingual and demographically diverse real-speech evaluation is necessary to establish their generality.
paragraphs.zh: 语言与人口统计学覆盖范围。 MPTB 仅限于英语，其口音多样性也局限于合成过程中采样的语音，而非具有代表性的真实世界说话人群体。 我们并未系统性地评估模型在不同语言、地域口音或说话人群体特征上的泛化能力。 轮流发言的惯例、韵律线索以及打断行为可能因语言和社文化背景的不同而有所差异。 因此，不应将我们的研究结果视为对话中话语权控制的普遍模式；要确立其普适性，有必要开展更广泛的多语言且人口统计学特征多样化的真实语音评估。

paragraphs.en: The released MPTB corpus contains synthetic speech and fictional LLM-generated dialogue rather than newly collected private conversations. The benchmark is designed to diagnose conversational control failures and should not be interpreted as a safety certification for deployment. Real TurnBench material used for scorer validation is not redistributed, and AMI is used under its existing research terms. Because full-duplex systems may be used in multi-user or high-stakes settings, benchmark performance should be considered alongside broader evaluations of recognition quality, safety, fairness, privacy, and task correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 已发布的 MPTB 语料库包含合成语音和虚构的 LLM 生成对话，而非新收集的私人对话。 该基准测试旨在诊断对话控制失败问题，不应被解读为部署的安全认证。 用于评分器验证的真实 TurnBench 材料不会重新分发，而 AMI 则在其现有的研究条款下使用。 由于全双工系统可能用于多用户或高风险场景，因此应将基准测试性能与对识别质量、安全性、公平性、隐私性和任务正确性的更广泛评估结合起来考虑。

paragraphs.en: Although MPTB derives floor-state labels before speech synthesis, a procedurally valid event may not be perceived as intended in the rendered audio. We therefore conduct a human validation study assessing whether listeners recognize the intended event categories and their temporal realization. The study covers all 240 conversations and 6,116 candidate events, with three independent annotations per event (18,348 primary categorical judgments, excluding blind repeats).
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 MPTB 在语音合成前会推导出底层状态标签，但程序上有效的事件在渲染后的音频中可能无法被感知为预期中的事件。 因此，我们开展了一项人类验证研究，评估听众是否能够识别预期的事件类别及其时间上的实现方式。 该研究涵盖了全部 240 次对话和 6,116 个候选事件，每个事件均有三名独立标注者进行标注（共 18,348 项主要类别判断，不包括重复标注）。

paragraphs.en: Annotators have native or near-native English comprehension and complete written guidelines, worked audio examples, and a held-out calibration set emphasizing turn completion versus continuation, backchannels versus floor claims, and successful versus unsuccessful interruptions. Qualification requires at least 75% agreement with expert labels across 10 calibration examples. Annotators are blinded to generator labels, event logs, and model predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 标注员需具备母语或接近母语的英语理解能力，并掌握完整的书面指南、带音频示例的说明材料以及一个预留的校准集；该校准集重点强调对话轮次的完成与延续、反馈信号与发言权主张，以及成功与失败的中断行为。 通过资格认证要求在与专家标签对比的10个校准示例中，至少达成75%的一致性。 标注员不得知晓生成器标签、事件日志和模型预测结果。

paragraphs.en: Annotators inspect candidate regions with 10 s of preceding and following context using synchronized multi-speaker audio, independently controllable speaker channels, and a shared timeline. For each region, they assign an event category, identify the perceived floor holder before and after the event, and mark onset and offset timestamps. An ambiguous label is permitted when the floor outcome cannot be determined reliably. Automatic transcripts are available as references, but audio takes precedence. paragraphs.en: Table 6 reports agreement across the six generated event categories. Backchannels show the strongest consistency, with 93.6% categorical consensus, Fleiss’ κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 , and boundary F1 of 0.95. paragraphs.en: The human study provides complementary evidence that MPTB’s generated floor-state categories have recognizable acoustic and conversational realizations, while identifying residual ambiguity in floor transitions, particularly successful interruptions. Since candidate regions are selected from the generator event log and annotators may inspect future context, these findings validate event-label plausibility rather than independent event discovery or real-time detectability. The study also does not establish that synthetic speech captures the full variability of natural multi-party interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 这项人类研究提供了补充证据，表明 MPTB 生成的楼层状态类别具有可识别的声学表现和对话实现方式，同时也揭示了楼层转换中残留的模糊性，尤其是在成功打断的情况下。 由于候选区域是从生成器事件日志中选择的，而标注者可能会查看未来的上下文，因此这些发现验证的是事件标签的合理性，而非独立的事件发现或实时可检测性。 该研究也未证实合成语音能够捕捉到自然多轮互动中的所有变异性。

paragraphs.en: Scoring anchors are derived deterministically from the canonical event log, separately for every speaker channel s s :

paragraphs.en: EOT positives : turn events of s s with outcome yield ; anchor t t = segment offset. The last turn of a conversation is a yield.

paragraphs.en: EOT hard negatives : turn events of s s with outcome hold ; scored span = [pause onset, same-speaker resume onset].
paragraphs.zh: EOT硬负例：将结果保持的s s事件转换；得分跨度 = [停顿开始，同说话人恢复开始]。

paragraphs.en: EOT excluded : turn events of s s with outcome interrupted ; a ± 0.25 \pm 0.25 s neighborhood around the forced stop is neither rewarded nor penalized.
paragraphs.zh: 排除的结束事件（EOT）：s s 中结果被中断的事件；强制停止前后各 ±0.25 秒的时间范围既不会获得奖励，也不会受到惩罚。

paragraphs.en: INT positives : claim_floor events of s s resolved as interruption ; anchor t t = claim onset on the interrupter’s own channel.
paragraphs.zh: INT 正例：s s 的 claim_floor 事件被判定为中断；锚点 t t = 中断方自身频道上的 claim 开始时间。

paragraphs.en: INT hard negatives : vocalize_no_claim events of s s (backchannel or laughter); scored span = [onset, offset].

paragraphs.en: Generation proceeds in five stages. (1) An LLM writes a role-tagged dialogue conditioned on party count, interaction type, and target rates for backchannels and interruptions. (2) A deterministic state machine resolves floor claims, holds, yields, and overlaps into a timed event graph. (3) Kokoro-82M renders each speaker using a disjoint voice pool. (4) A controlled noise stage adds procedural ambient sound, discrete non-content events, and intermittent distant speech. (5) The assembler emits synchronized per-speaker audio and the exact event log. Scripts, seeds, audio manifests, and scorer inputs are recorded for reproducibility. The remainder of this section specifies every stage.

paragraphs.en: Scripts are generated by gpt-4.1 (all 240 conversations) with the system prompt and user template of Figures 7 and 8 , temperature 0.9, a 8,000-token output limit and JSON output. Each utterance carries exactly one event type ( turn , claim_floor , vocalize_no_claim ), a qualitative timing hint and, where applicable, a target holder and a resolution hint. Outputs are validated against structural rules (first utterance is a turn ; claims and vocalizations require a current holder and target it; every speaker holds at least one turn ; at least max ⁡ ( 2 ​ N , 8 ) \max(2N,8) turns; closed tag and hint vocabularies). A failed validation is returned to the model with the error list for repair, up to three attempts with seeds seed + k \text{seed}+k . Before validation, any backchannel longer than three words is deterministically relabelled as a non-floor-taking claim, so that multi-word listener speech is never scored as an INT negative. Realized scripts contain 6,800 utterances (28.3 per conversation): 4,347 turn (median 16 words), 367 successful claims (median 9 words), 605 failed claims (median 5 words), 1,176 backchannels (median 1 word) and 305 laughter vocalizations (median 2 words).

A discrete-event state machine consumes the script in order and maintains the floor holder. A turn by a new speaker closes the previous holder’s segment as a yield and starts the new segment after a gap drawn from the timing hint. A turn by the current holder continues the segment; if the open segment is at least 4 s long, a mid-turn pause is inserted with probability 0.45, closing the segment as a hold and producing an EOT hard negative. A successful claim_floor starts inside the holder’s ongoing utterance, the holder keeps talking briefly in overlap and is then truncated ( interrupted ), and the floor transfers. A failed claim and a vocalization overlap the holder without changing the floor. Utterance durations come from the synthesized audio, so timing is resolved against real speech lengths. Table 17 lists every distribution; all draws use the conversation seed.

Each utterance is synthesized independently with Kokoro-82M ( hexgrad, 2024 ) ( hexgrad/Kokoro-82M ) at 24 kHz, speed 1.0, with a per-utterance seed derived from the text and voice. Leading and trailing silence below − 40 -40 dBFS is trimmed with a 30 ms margin, and clips are cached by content hash so re-rendering is byte-reproducible. Abstract voice ids map to Kokoro voices as in Table 18 . The 24 voices are split gender-balanced into 8 development and 16 test voices; no voice occurs in both splits, and no voice is reused within a conversation.

Clips are placed on per-speaker channels at the orchestrated times; truncated holder clips receive a 30 ms fade, and each channel is peak-normalized to − 1 -1 dBFS. A single noise realization is added to all channels of a conversation (one room, N N microphones), so nuisance sounds are cross-channel. Table 19 gives the noise model and its realized distribution; sound effects and distant speech are drawn from MUSAN ( Snyder et al., 2015 ) . If the mixture exceeds − 1 -1 dBFS, one common gain is applied to all channels, preserving inter-channel levels.

Each conversation is released as N N noisy evaluation channels and N N clean channels (FLAC, 24 kHz), the tagged script, the canonical event log, a render sidecar listing every clip with its placement and truncation, the noise manifest, and the seed. An automatic acoustic check runs on the clean channels: (Q1) audio length matches the event log; (Q2) per-channel speech ratio in [ 0.03 , 0.99 ] [0.03,0.99] ; (Q3) at least 50% of each scheduled clip span is voiced; (Q4) at most 30% voiced time outside scheduled clips; (Q5) at least 60% of overlap events (interruptions, failed claims, vocalizations) have both mover and holder voiced. All 240 conversations pass. Across the corpus, 2,369 of 2,436 overlap events (97.2%) are acoustically realized as simultaneous speech, median clip coverage is 0.81, and no channel shows speech leakage outside its clips.

MPTB crosses four speaker counts ( N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} ) with six interaction types, yielding 24 conditions with 10 conversations each. The resulting 240 conversations comprise 6.89 hours of speech, partitioned into 48 development and 192 test conversations with disjoint speaker voices. Table 20 provides event counts and conversational statistics for each condition. Although conversation counts are balanced, realized positive and negative event counts vary across conditions.

Speaker count has a comparatively limited effect on aggregate conversational dynamics: overlap remains between 10.2 and 11.0 seconds per dialogue, while interruption rates increase from 0.70/min at two speakers to approximately 0.97/min at five. Interaction type induces larger differences in conversational behavior. Casual conversations have the fastest exchanges (19.4 events/min) and shortest turns (4.81 s), whereas Narrative conversations exhibit longer turns (9.22 s) and fewer interruptions (0.53/min). Collaborative dialogue has the highest interruption rate (1.33/min). These differences establish distinct floor-management regimes within the balanced design, enabling evaluation across conversational styles without conflating them with speaker count.

Adding speakers spreads the floor rather than speeding up exchanges. The share of floor-holding time taken by the most active speaker falls from 60.4% at N = 2 N{=}2 to 51.4%, 41.0% and 36.4% at N = 3 , 4 , 5 N{=}3,4,5 , while speaker changes per minute stay between 7.6 and 9.1 (Table 9 ). Hold negatives become rarer with N N (74 at N = 2 N{=}2 vs. 48 at N = 5 N{=}5 ) as mean floor segments shorten (7.07 to 6.26 s); mid-turn pauses are only inserted into segments of at least 4 s (Table 17 ). Listener activity grows over the same range (3.12 to 4.06 backchannels/min).

The offline suite covers twelve systems in three families of floor-control systems. Acoustic detectors include RMS energy, WebRTC VAD ( Google WebRTC Project, ) , and Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) . Semantic endpoint detectors include Smart Turn v2 ( Pipecat AI, 2025 ) , Kyutai Semantic-VAD ( Kyutai, ) , and the Mimi Endpointer ( Udupa et al., 2025 ) . Turn-taking models include Voice Activity Projection (VAP) ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ) , MuVAP ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , DualTurn ( Rajaa, 2026 ) , the WavLM-Large anchor ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Turn-1-Mini ( p99lab, 2026 ) , and the ESPnet turn-taking model ( Arora et al., 2025b ) . Table 22 gives the exact checkpoint, input configuration and score mapping of every system.

For multi-party evaluation, two-channel models (VAP, MuVAP, Mimi Endpointer, DualTurn) operate in a speaker-versus-rest configuration, treating each participant as the candidate speaker and the mean of the remaining channels as the conversational context. Single-channel models run independently on every speaker channel; ESPnet is reported on the mono mixture of all channels. Systems are evaluated on the noisy, channel-separated MPTB recordings, and all inference is causal: each score is time-stamped at the end of the audio it has consumed. Except for VAP, which gates on its own voice-activity head, every learned INT score is gated by “another speaker is active” from WebRTC VAD (aggressiveness 2) on the other channels. Turn-1-Mini releases only its end-of-turn head and is evaluated only on EOT ; no INT output is inferred from its predictions. All tunable detectors use thresholds selected on the 48-conversation development split and held fixed on the 192-conversation test split, following Section 4 . Thresholds are not adjusted for individual speaker counts or interaction types. The threshold grids, selected thresholds and development scores are listed in Table 27 .

To examine the transferability of results obtained from synthetic speech, we evaluate compatible offline detectors on two real-audio datasets: a dyadic subset of TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) comprising 12 conversations, and a four-party subset of AMI ( Carletta and others, 2006 ) comprising 15 meetings (approximately 7.1 hours). The TurnBench subset uses consensus annotations, while AMI floor events are derived from its manual segment and word annotations using a documented floor-state mapping.

The same event definitions and scoring procedure are applied across datasets, with dataset-specific operating points selected where development data are available. Since the datasets differ in recording conditions, interaction structure, and speaker composition, cross-corpus comparisons characterize domain sensitivity rather than isolating a causal effect of speaker count.

Consensus anchors are rebuilt from the three released annotator tracks with ± 200 \pm 200 ms endpoint agreement, following TurnBench’s protocol. The slice contains 287 EOT positives, 571 hold spans, 107 INT positives and 1,272 negatives.

Each AMI headset channel is one speaker. A single floor holder is tracked over the manual transcriber segments with the thresholds in Table 23 ; the resulting events pass through the same anchor derivation and scorer as MPTB. Over the 15 meetings this yields 1,458 EOT positives, 862 hold spans, 1,295 INT positives and 1,255 INT negatives (17.3 events, 2.95 backchannels and 3.04 interruptions per minute).

We construct 120 interactive scenarios spanning four event conditions: true end-of-turn, mid-turn hold pause, successful interruption, and backchannel (30 each). Scenarios are balanced across N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } N\in\{2,3,4\} and the six interaction types. Each scenario is evaluated three times on five full-duplex systems: GPT-Live-1 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.8-Live ( Google, 2026 ) , MiniCPM-o-4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , Realtime-Venus ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , and Step-Audio-3-Realtime ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , yielding 1,800 attempted trials. Agents receive streaming speech without access to scenario labels or reference event times.

The START probe measures whether an agent correctly enters the conversational floor. A response following a genuine EOT is counted as a correct start, while speaking during a mid-turn hold pause constitutes a false start. We denote the corresponding rates by S S and F ​ S FS .

The STOP probe measures whether an agent relinquishes the floor appropriately. The agent is first induced to produce a multi-second response, during which an incoming speaker either successfully interrupts or produces a backchannel. Yielding to a genuine interruption constitutes a correct stop; yielding to a backchannel constitutes a false stop. We denote these rates by Y Y and F ​ Y FY .

Both probes use the balanced-accuracy and action-bias definitions in Section 4 , with ( Recall , FPR ) = ( S , F ​ S ) (\mathrm{Recall},\mathrm{FPR})=(S,FS) for START and ( Y , F ​ Y ) (Y,FY) for STOP.

Provider-specific adapters record incoming audio timestamps, assistant speech intervals, emitted audio, and available interruption or cancellation events on a common monotonic clock. START trials require an observable opportunity for the agent to respond; STOP trials additionally require the agent to be speaking when the probe is injected. Trials failing the relevant observability conditions are excluded from behavioral scoring.

Table 24 places MPTB next to three real-speech sources. TurnBench official reports the published TurnBench leaderboard (real dyadic studio speech; 116 test conversations; TurnBench’s own runs and operating points). TurnBench dev slice applies our scorer and our detector implementations to 12 real dyadic development conversations with consensus anchors (287 EOT positives / 571 hold spans; 107 INT positives / 1,272 negatives). AMI meetings uses 15 four-party headset meetings (7.09 h; ES2002a–d, ES2003a, ES2004a, ES2005a, IS1000a–b, IS1001a–b, TS3003a–b, TS3004a–b) with floor events derived from the manual segment annotations (1,458 EOT positives / 862 hold spans; 1,295 INT positives / 1,255 negatives; mapping in Appendix E.2 ). On both real slices thresholds are tuned in-slice.

The single system evaluated on all four sources is VAP. Its EOT recall decreases from 92.6% (MPTB) to 84.5% (TurnBench official), 79.1% (dev slice) and 52.1% (AMI). Its INT recall is 94.5% on official dyadic TurnBench, 61.7% on the dev slice, 35.9% on four-party AMI and 11.7% on MPTB, with FPR between 2.8% and 10.7% in every case. AMI is also denser in interruptions than MPTB (3.04 vs. 0.89 per minute).

Kyutai’s INT score fires on 0.2% of one-word listener vocalizations, 5.7% of two- or three-word ones, and 72.3% of negatives with four or more words, all of which are laughter vocalizations such as “ Haha, yeah, I’ve been waiting all week for this one ”. Its recall on true interruptions also grows with claim length (37.2% for 1–3 words vs. 62.6% for 9+ words). Its INT advantage over VAP (Table 29 ) therefore comes largely from duration, not from modelling floor ownership. DualTurn and MuVAP show the same direction with flatter slopes (26.2% FPR on 4+-word negatives), and all learned systems false-alarm more on laughter than on backchannels except ESPnet.

For Kyutai, Mimi Endpointer, MuVAP, DualTurn and Smart Turn, false EOT triggers on hold pauses are most frequent when the pre-pause clause ends in a question mark (33 spans; e.g., DualTurn 18.2% vs. 10.8% after a period, Smart Turn 24.2% vs. 11.7%), and every learned system detects true yields after questions more reliably than yields after statements (e.g., VAP 96.9% vs. 90.8%). This is consistent with reliance on clause completion, a cue that a hold after a question does not follow. WavLM Anchor false-alarms on 20.5–23.4% of hold spans of every clause type and Turn-1-Mini on 27.3–29.7% after complete clauses, which is the source of their over-budget test FPR.

In 28 of the 186 test hold spans, another listener’s failed floor claim overlaps the holder’s pause, so the floor is briefly contested before the holder resumes. These contested holds account for most false EOT triggers of the speaker-versus-rest models (Table 31 ): VAP false-alarms on 39.3% of them versus 1.9% of uncontested holds (11 of its 14 false alarms), MuVAP on 57.1% versus 1.9%, and DualTurn on 42.9% versus 5.1%. Kyutai, which scores each channel in isolation, is nearly unaffected (7.1% vs. 3.8%). These models read a competing voice in the pooled “rest” channel as the holder releasing the floor. Contested holds make up 10.9% of hold spans at N = 2 N{=}2 and 15.4–18.2% at N = 3 N{=}3 –5, and with more listeners the competing voice can come from any of N − 1 N-1 channels that the pooled rest stream merges.

Gemini-3.8-Live is accessed through the Live WebSocket API with the provider’s default voice activity handling (voice Puck ). Table 34 breaks accuracy down by party count and reports run-to-run consistency (the fraction of scenarios on which all valid repeats agree). The STOP failures are stable properties of each agent, not noise: MiniCPM-o ignores 73 of 74 valid interruptions with perfect consistency, and Gemini yields to 86 of 88 backchannels. GPT-Live-1 is the least deterministic agent on STOP (consistency .40 on interruptions and .60 on backchannels), and its yield rate grows with N N (35% at N = 2 N{=}2 to 65% at N = 4 N{=}4 ) together with its backchannel accuracy (48% to 75%).

Table 35 reports START latency as the agent’s speech onset relative to the end of the genuine turn, and STOP latency as the time from injection of the interrupting speech to the end of the agent’s ongoing utterance, over all valid trials. Gemini stops 230 ms (median) after an interruption begins, in line with provider-side cancellation on detected input speech (Table 36 ). MiniCPM-o (median 8.6 s) and Venus (3.0 s) finish their ongoing answer before going silent, which is why their interruption accuracy is near zero under the 1.5 s stop window.

Table 36 separates provider-driven cancellation from model-driven yielding. Every Gemini stop on a true interruption, and 95.5% of its stops on backchannels, coincide with a provider barge-in event; its STOP behavior is therefore the provider’s voice-activity cancellation policy, which cannot distinguish a backchannel from a takeover. The other agents expose no cancel events, so their stops are model decisions. In 61.7% of its valid interruption trials, GPT-Live-1 starts a new utterance within 2 s of ending the interrupted one, so a yield is often a brief pause followed by reclaiming the floor.
